status: Design proposals only, except the implemented farmland exclusion. Not read by runtime spawners.
metric: Percentage of eligible 7 m ground cells occupied by stationary elements. Targets are occupied-cell budgets, not direct per-attempt spawn probabilities.

GRASS.intent: Open meadow: broad grass clumps with a few ordinary flowers; marigolds become uncommon.

FOREST.intent: Canopy and fungi: tree stands, nut litter and mushrooms; fewer shrubs so the canopy reads clearly.

SAND.intent: Mostly open sand, with shells and driftwood concentrated along the tide line.

FARMLAND.intent: Excluded: no generated objects, plants, wildlife or enemies. This restriction is implemented; other targets remain proposals.

RESIDENTIAL.intent: Broken yard edges: mundane rubble, sparse grass and shrubs. Keep usable street frontage clear.

PARK.intent: Keep the four park characters distinct. Targets below apply only outside nexus coverage.

ROCK.intent: Natural outcrop clusters: stone with visible ore pockets and broad clear gaps.

SCHOOL.intent: Open grounds with small blue forget-me-not beds at accessible edges; no marigold scatter.

COMMERCIAL.intent: Geometric hedge and pot rows around clear plazas; avoid a meadow-like flower scatter.

INDUSTRIAL.intent: Worked rubble and salvage barrels with clear aisles; fewer stone piles than natural rock. Ore stays uncommon.

PLAYGROUND.intent: Open play space; a few ordinary flowers and grass tufts at the edges.

PITCH.intent: Keep the field centre clear; only sparse edge grass.

WETLAND.intent: Reedy grass bands and damp mushrooms around open channels; fewer flowers and dry-looking shrubs.

GOLF.intent: Clear fairways with longer grass concentrated in rough and boundaries.

ORCHARD.intent: Regular fruit-tree rows with an open, lightly grassy understory. Source farmland restrictions still take priority.

WASTELAND.intent: Irregular rubble and scrub patches, visibly rougher than residential frontage.

meadow.intent: Open lawn with concentrated wildflower patches.

wooded.intent: Small tree stands and shaded mushrooms.

formal.intent: Straight clipped hedge rows and bounded marigold beds.

common.intent: Mostly open lawn with a few irregular tufts.
